traits.name: Hardened Exterior
traits.text:
Bludgeoning, piercing, and
slashing damage the overlord takes from nonmagical
weapons is reduced by 3 to a minimum of 1.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The overlord's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: * At will: light, shape stone * 3/day each: transmute rock, wall of stone * 1/day each: bones of the earth

traits.name: Stone Camouflage
traits.text:
The overlord has advantage on
Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.

traits.name: Sturdy
traits.text:
The overlord has advantage on saving throws
against effects that would cause it to move or be
knocked prone.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The overlord makes two attacks with its
stone gauntlet or with its stone spike.

actions.name: Stone Gauntlet
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach
5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning
damage.

actions.name: Stone Spike
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range
30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing
damage.

actions.name: Rupturing Wave (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text:
The overlord slams its
gauntleted first to the ground and causes a 10-foot
wide, 60-foot long line of jagged stone erupts from the
ground. Each creature in the line must make a DC 14
Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d8) bludgeoning
damage and 22 (4d8) piercing damage on a failed save,
or half as much damage on a successful one. The area
in this line is considered difficult terrain until the
rubble is cleared.

actions.name: From the Rubble (1/Day)
actions.text:
The overlord uses spare stone
and rubble in the area to restore health to its allies. Up
to four other corlapis the overlord can see regain 22
(4d8 + 4) hit points.
